{{Guide|B0aty}}
== [[B0aty]] HCIM Guide v3.0 (70 Herblore Brickwall) ==
Tpapa created this guide & I stole it and created it to try and be as non-competitive as possible with other players to hopefully prevent early bottlenecking. It is a [[Ironman]]/[[HCIM]] route to [[Song of the Elves]] completion with little downtime for 70 [[herblore]] requirement. We also complete [[Recipe for Disaster]], [[Perilous Moons|Moons of Peril]], [[Royal Titans]] & maybe [[Piety]]. Throughout play ALL lamps go to Herblore. If the guide mentions 'Continue/Continue until/Complete X quest, you can start a quest helper for this quest and follow as directed. There is a LOT of multi-questing so you will be ignoring Quest Helper a lot. Main account alt recommended but not required for any steps.

Do all [[Random Events]] except: [[Maze]], [[Mime (Random Event)|Mime]], [[Drill Demon|Camo]] & [[Gravedigger]]

This guide DOES NOT include any [[LMS]] but if you enjoy LMS and enjoy [[PvP]] or want to learn a bit, I HEAVILY advise going to LMS at 750 total and getting [[Rune Arrow]]s to [[Alch]] while questing.

I would heavily recommend the 'Time Tracking & Time Tracking Reminder' plugins. You want to do a Farm Run & [[Birdhouse run]] almost any time you are withdrawing new gear for the next step if they are ready. IT IS NOT WORTH teleporting out of [[slayer]] tasks and mid [[quest]] to do these.

Keep 2x Seeds in Seed Vault at all times for contracts. Only do a herb run when you have a surplus of 5-6 seeds

As there is a hard 70 [[Agility]] requirement for Song of the Elves, it is extremely efficient to get this completed as soon as possible even though agility sucks as you will then have improved energy restoration, [[Graceful]] & 1M+ [[Coins]] from [[Agility Pyramid]] before starting. You will have to get 70 Agility anyway and the methods don't viably improve. Some optional methods to make early fast GP on accounts this guide doesn't mention:

* Early [[revenants]] (initial 100k required)
* 1+1 [[Soul wars]] (40 combat requirement)
* LMS Rune Arrows (750 total req+30QP req)*
* [[Blackjacking]] with [[Rogue equipment]]
* Agility Pyramid
* [[Eclipse Red]]'s
<sub>*You can sell rune arrows to the Market Seller in Pollnivneach for around 200 each (10-15 per world) to pay for nature runes to alch the rest.</sub>

Upon creating your account, DO NOT choose a username with the words or phrases ‘Iron’ ‘HC’ ‘Fe’, 'GIM', 'GIMP'. This is the most important step of the guide.

Use all Lamps on Herblore after quest is complete unless specified

A lot of the time the guide will assume you have combat gear on you. Sometimes it is specified, sometimes it is not. I would always have a weapon/ammunition on you to kill monsters. Magic solves almost every fight except for [[Black Knight Titan]]

===Guide specific terminology===
'''Macroquesting:''' Macroquesting is the process of completing multiple quests simultaneously, progressing your account in an "optimal" way, ensuring that the maximum number of quests are being done during any given visit to an area. It's a crucial part of efficient gameplay, for use when making alternate (possibly Ironman) accounts. For a given style of gameplay, it's theoretically possible to "solve" the exact chain of quest steps and item gathering grinds, however there is currently insufficient data in a suitable format to build such a solver.

==Guide==

===Episode 1 - Banks 1 through 24:===

{{Checklist|title=Starting out|*Starting Out
** All Settings -> Disable level-up
** Talk to [[Father Aereck]] (3,1) [Restless Ghost]
** Pickpocket a man/woman [Lumbridge Easy Diary]
** Head North-West to [[Magic combat tutor]] & drop Air & Mind Runes and claim more.
** Sell Bronze Dagger, Sword, Wooden Shield & Shortbow to General Store. Buy a Spade Chisel & hammer
** Head East & Start X Marks the Spot on Veos (2,1) & complete the first step (Install Quest Helper plug in on Runelite)
** Check playtime on [[Hans]] [Lumbridge Easy Diary]
** Go upstairs and Talk to [[Duke Horacio]] (1,1) [Rune Mysteries]
** Go upstairs again and Collect 4x logs on the top floor [Tree Gnome Village]
** Bank at Lumbridge castle top floor and deposit all
** Keep the Shrimps in your bank for later [Family Crest Quest]
** Move Coins into first bank slot & Runes to the top slots. Click the lock to Always set Placeholders. Set Bank pin for Count Check randoms or delete the pin from Tutorial Island.
}}

{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|
* Withdraw: Coins, Air Runes, Mind Runes, Bread, Spade, Tinderbox, Air Talisman, Treasure Scroll (8 Inventory slots)
* Go down south staircase twice (Right-Click 'Bottom-floor')
* Collect the Empty Jug, Bowl & Knife in Lumbridge kitchen
* Fill the jug & bowl on the sink in the kitchen [Monk's Friend]
* Complete 2nd Step of X Marks The Spot
* Kill a giant rat with Wind Strike and collect the Bones + Raw Rat Meat [Druidic Ritual]
* Head West towards Draynor hugging the fence to avoid the Jail Guards
* Talk to [[Father Urhney]] in the lumbridge swamp for Ghost Speak Amulet. (2,1) Wield this.
* Take Leather Gloves on the table inside his house & wield
* Head to the Wizards Tower
* Take Leather Boots off the table & wield
* Collect 3x Logs next to the stairs [Tree Gnome Village]
* Head to the basement & Talk to [[Sedridor]] to continue Rune Mysteries (1,2,1)
* Kill a Chicken. Take Everything (Make sure you get a feather, else hop worlds and repeat)[Client of Kourend + Druidic Ritual]
* Collect 3x Logs [Tree Gnome Village]
* Head north to Draynor & talk to [[Friendly Forester]] and obtain Forestry kit (right click shop and buy 1)
* Bank at Draynor and Deposit all

{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|
* Withdraw: Coins, Spade, Feather & Mysterious Orb (4 Inventory Slots)

* Train Draynor Agility to 5 Agility [Lumbridge Easy Diary]

* Check the Notice board next to Fortunato to Start [[A Porcine of Interest]]
* Complete 4th Step of X Marks the Spot
* Head West to Port Sarim and talk to [[Veos]] to complete X Marks The Spot.
* Destroy the lamp. You can collect this later as you can't bank it.
* Travel to Port Piscarilius via Veos
* Talk to [[Veos]] (4,1) [Client of Kourend]
* Take the [[Raeli|Minecart]] to Shayzien East (option B)
* Open Minimap & follow the path South-West to Shayzien
* Take the Beer
* Use your Feather on the Enchanted scroll in your inventory
* Head west to the General store, Talk to [[Jennifer_(Shayzien)]] for Client of Kourend (3,2)
* Take the Tinderbox
* Take Wizard Hat & Orange Dye [Shadow of the Storm, Goblin Diplomacy] from house to the west (Shayzien Styles)
* Trade [[Robyn]] and buy a [[Chef's Hat]]  [Cook's guild]
* Home teleport to Lumbridge
* Talk to [[Bob]] and buy a Steel Axe
* Search the Coffin, south-east in the graveyard. Talk to [[Restless Ghost]] (1)
* Talk to [[Count Check]] and be teleported to Stronghold of Security (3,1)
* Complete 3 Floors of Stronghold of Security. (Answer the questions or spam click doors)
* On Floor 3, Spider max is 7 so if you take 3 or more damage, drink a wine before going through the door to avoid being stacked. Take the east doors.
* [[Catablepon]] Max is 9 so drink on any damage.
* Once you have 10,000GP from Floor 3, leave via the ropes
* Collect 3x Beer inside the Longhall
* Collect a Cooked Meat [Mournings End Pt 2]
* Head east and Talk to [[Gertude]] (1) [Gertrudes Cat]
* Collect a Doogle Leaf south of Gertrude
* Bank at Varrock West Bank and deposit all

* Shear a sheep by the Makeover Mage
* Take Falador Crumbling wall Shortcut [Falador Easy Diary]
* Bank at Falador West Bank and deposit all

{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|
* Withdraw: Rogue Outfit, Few food, Seedbox, Garden Pie

* Medium Farming Contracts are excellent for Irit seeds. Song of the Elves has a hard requirement of 70 herblore so you will want to complete as many Farming contracts as necessary. Use CIR Fairy ring to return to Farming Guild. Thieve Master Farmers whenever you need seeds. You will probably complete every step on this guide and still not have 70 Herblore so upkeeping contracts is extremely important to prevent a bottleneck.
* Plant Hespori asap with Garden Pie. When this is fully grown the next day come in, pray magic (You may not have protect magic prayer unlocked yet by the time its grown. If so wait until you get the prayer level), and start the fight with your bronze/iron/steel knives and kill all 4 flowers for a hard CA. You will not be ready to actually kill the hespori so just get the CA and quick-escape on the cave exit. Hespori is VERY dangerous at this stage so be careful.
* Farm Limpwurts everytime you return (you need 20 for Temple of Ikov)
* Medium preplant is Maple, Irit, Cactus, Jangerberries, Watermelon, Limpwurt
* OPTIONAL: Buy 22 Baskets and fill with oranges at Grand Tree to protect Maples
* Plant Belladonnas for Seren Fight
* Plant Strawberries at Ardougne Patch

{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|
* Withdraw: 1 Law Rune, 5 Air Runes, Studded Body & Chaps & Coif, Graceful Legs, Boots of Lightness, 2x ring of recoil, Pendant of Lucien, 23 Karambwans

* Check Recoil has over 20 charges. (Make sure you have a 2nd in inventory)
* Continue Temple of Ikov Quest
* NOTE: Quest helper may be bugged here, so follow these steps:
* Enter the [[Temple of Ikov (dungeon)]] via the entrence south of the [[Ranging Guild]]
* WARNING (HCIM): Be careful crossing the bridge, if you weight more than 0kg, you will fall and take 20 hp damage
* Upon entering, immediately drop all your food and studded chaps to reduce your weight below 0kg (drop it in front of the ladder)
* Cross the bridge in the north room and pick up the lever while weighing less than 0kg
* Use the lever on the lever bracket in the entrance room
* Pull the lever
* Pick up your items from the ground and continue the quest entering the south gate
* Search the chests for [[Ice Arrows]] only need a few you won’t use them since you'll be using knives
* Return back to the entry room when you have some ice arrows
* Go into the north room, then on the north side right-click search the lever there for traps, then pull it
* Equip your studded chaps
* Try to enter the far north door. Be prepared to fight Lesarkus, kill him using your knives
* Max hit 8 (Retake Knives while eating)
* Teleport to Camelot

<!-- Bank 104 -->
{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|
* Withdraw: Best Air Spell, Spade, Ardy Cloak, Dramen Staff, Recoil Rings, Full Inventory of best food
* Ardy Cloak -> BKR 
* Run South East and take the Rowboat to Mort'ton 
* NOTE: THIS IS HOW U RETURN TO BARROWS TOO
* Head to Barrows
* Talk to [[Strange Old Man]] to start His Faithful Servants
* Feel free to spend as long as you need on this, even if you need to bank after every kill. Completing His Faithful Servants will get you 43 Prayer and game mode becomes EZ until Late Game. 
* Barrows are weak to Wind Spells so use Wind Blast
* MAX HITS: Ahrim 20, Dharok 29 (57 on 1 hp), Guthan 24, Karil 20, Torag 23, Verac 23
* STRATEGY: Kill Karil First (If Karil is tunnel mentioned later)
* You want to trade 1:1 with Karil. He maxes 20 so heal everytime you are 20 or over Hitpoints from your maximum. This may use most or all of your food so teleport out when needed. 
* Kill Ahrim with protect from magic, bring jangerberries to restore 1 prayer point if you get drained and 1-tick/lazy flick.
* Find your tunnel (Enter a Melee brother Mound, search the mound and click the stairs instantly. You won't get hit but you cent get 1 banged anyway so don't worry. 
* Once you find your Crypt we are going to safespot them to avoid any mistakes. You can safespot them on the ladder, invisible ladders & on rocks.
* Turn NPC 'Attack' Options to 'Always Right-click'
* Open Crypt doors to force spawn the Melee brothers. Safespot approprietly until all 4 are dead.
* IF Karil tunnel, you want to head all the way to the chest and trade 1:1 respectively using the lamps as obstacles
* NOTE: MAKE SURE YOU HAVE SPACE BEFORE YOU LOOT THE CHEST
* Talk to [[Strange Old Man]] to complete His Faithful Servants
* Teleport anywhere and bank. 43 Prayer makes everything much easier now
}}

{{Checklist|title=Complete these skills whenever you want|
* 70 Construction - Teak Logs from Kingdom. Use Butler in POH for planks. Mahogany homes until 70. 400-600 Oak Planks -> 50, 2,300 Teak Planks 50-70 (This should cost you about 2.5m gp)
* 70 Mining - 3t Sand and deposit in the grinder for future grinds. Leave for Herb Runs and use Camulet to return
* 70 Herblore - Do as many herbruns/medium farming contracts as possible. Moons will bank quite alot of the XP
* 70 Farming - Should be completed passively.
* 70 Hunter - Should be completed passively with BHRs.
}}
{{Checklist|title=Training melee combat & slayer|
* Make some Super Attack, Super Strength & Prayer Potions
* Train Slayer to 48 with an ancient staff as your weapon on Attack Mode
* Gear: Ancient Staff, Amulet of Strength, Barrows Gloves, Climbing Boots, Berserker Helmet
* Withdraw: Teleport Runes, Coins, Melee & Range Combat Gear, Sven's Last Map, Spade, some food
* Ardy Cloak -> DKS
* Dig by Windswept Tree
* Kill a Brine Rat [Fremennik Medium Diary]
* Teleport to Varrock
* Head to Varlamore
* Buy Mithril Platebody & Mithril Platelegs at the Blackmith West
* Complete Twilights Promise
* Start Perilous Moons until you unlock [[Sulphur Nagua]]s
* Train on Sulpha Naguas until 60 Attack (If you ever want to AFK, the Naguas are vastly superior to most things as you also passively get RuneCrafting while crazy combat experience. Karambwans and Naguas should be your go to AFKs before Gem Crab/Shooting stars. It is advised to complete Perilous Moons before AFKing Naguas as you will get crazy rates with Dual Macahuitl’s and Bloodmoon. 
* Buy a Dragon Scimitar at Ape Atoll (Bring a GreeGree)
* Train Slayer until 58 on Strength Mode until 65 Strength then switch to Attack until 65
* Collect Easy CA's from [[Ghommal]]. Lamp on herblore. Get a Dragon Defender at Warriors Guild, training on Defensive
* OPTIONAL: Rum Deal requires 47 Prayer (Boostable), you may have enough ensouled heads from 58 slayer to get this level
* Complete Rum Deal & Cabin Fever once 58 Slayer after Defender
* Start A Great Brain Robbery & plant Watermelons in the patch on Harmony Island
}}
{{Checklist|title=Combat Achievements|
* Complete Fire Cape if you're confident Meleeing after Defender
* OPTIONAL: Medium Combat Achievements before Barrows are fairly difficult to achieve at this point but possible, especially with friends to help with TOB entry mode. If you're planning to complete Medium Combat Achievements before Barrows the below CA's are all possible and recommended on the first KC run. Buy Dragon Halberd to safespot Bats & Healers.
* Fight Caves Veteran
* Facing Jad Head-on
* Denying the Healers I & II (I gargled Healers I)
* A Near Miss
* You Didn't Say Anything About a Bat (I also gargled this)
* Complete Scurrius Combat Achievements
* Kill Scurrius on Defensive (You are aiming for 65 Attack, 65 Strength and 680,000 Defence Experience)
* Teleport to Kourend. Enter Catacombs. Head West & climb the Vine for Giants Pit
* Complete Obor Combat Achievements - You need 1 key to do all of the CA's aside from the 5 KC task. You can farm 5 keys here.
* Complete Bryophyta Combat Achievements - You need 1 key to do all of the CA's aside from the 5 KC task. You can farm 5 keys here.

===Episode 7 - Further Combat Training/Questing through Barrows===
{{Youtube|FpiphrAyaIU}}

{{Checklist|title=Further Combat training/Questing|
* Minigame teleport to Trouble Brewing (take an axe and tinderbox)
* Complete a game of Trouble Brewing [Morytania Medium Diary] (can skip this if no alt/friend/active world and do later)
* Kill Cave Horrors until Black Mask drop. Train on Defensive until 680,000 Defence Experience. Once you get it head through the dungeon & cut & burn mahogany logs [Morytania Hard Diary]
* Kill Barbarbian Spirits in the Whirlpool for Mithril Grapple
* Train Strength to 70 after 680,000 Defence Experience
* Complete Kings Ransom
* Complete What Lies Below (You may need to get a Chaos Talisman from Leeches in Alternate Abyss; ALR)
* Start Defender of Varrock until you unlock Armoured Zombies
}}
{{Checklist|title=Zombie Axe|
* OPTIONAL: If you are not & want 70 Magic to burst Zombies and are confident going to DKS in Rune Armour, you can Iban Blast Rex for Berserker ring and some magic levels. Otherwise we do this after Barrows Gear. You can also alch at Rex waiting for them to spawn.
* Armoured Zombies drop the Zombie Axe which is an excellent mid tier weapon (used until Abyssal Whip). It is advised to hunt for this now using Ice Burst (If 70 magic). The best way is buying Ice Sacks from LMS and using them in a PvP World.  (IMPORTANT: ONCE YOU GET TO THE CAVE WITH THE ZOMBIES DO NOT CONTINUE THE QUEST BY LOOKING OVER THE LEDGES). Alternatively you can buy the runes.
* ANOTHER WARNING: DO NOT LOOK OVER THE LEDGES OR THE INSTANCE IS OVER AND YOU CAN GET BAGGED UP BY PKERS
* IT IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED TO SCOUT THE LADDER WITH AN ALT TO MAKE SURE YOU DON'T GET BAGGED UP IF DOING PVP WORLD METHOD.
* Also remember to change off PvP world if you bank but you can stay on 1 trip for 1,000+ KC (over drop rate)
* Don't cast on Defensive. If you can get 78 Magic before Barrows you can build a Barrows Portal with a +5 red stew boost.
* Another option is to complete Barrows before this and use the Runes from Barrows to burst the axe, but you may not have a barrows portal for Barrows which is slightly inefficient. The portal is not mandatory if you are not close. We only do a small bit of barrows.
* If you do the above, repair the axe
* Complete Knight Waves (flinch with Zombie Axe)
}}
{{Checklist|title=Barrows|
* IF 78+ Magic
* Boost with a Red Evil Dave stew to 83 Magic to make a Barrows Portal
* OPTIONAL: Medium CAs before Barrows (Do this anyway you want or can but the CAs I did are below)
* All Bryophyta
* All Obor
* All Wintertodt
* All Tempoross (except Angler outfit)
* ALL Scurrius
* Barrows; (All but 10/25 KC tasks)
* Deranged Archaeologist; (Magic only & dodging books) [GENUINELY BE CAREFUL ON THIS ONE. HE CAN HIT HARD]
* Giant Mole; (No damage kill)
* Hespori; (Hesporisn't, Weed Whacker, Plant-Based Diet)
* Hueycoatl; (10kc, earth spells, Pillar Lover, Speed Trialist, Perfect Huey) [Can do on Mass world]
* Jad Challenges; (Second Challenge + only melee) [This one is challenging so attempt for fun or skip]
* Chambers of Xeric: (No Falling Rocks Guardians, Long Range safespot a Shaman, Ice demon with no prayer, damage & fire spells, Tightrope Skip) [Scout the first room. 2x Phoenix Necklace & tick perfect for Rope skip(also maybe a skip as challenging)
* Entry TOB has some easy CAs otherwise the above is what I did. Medium before barrows IS NOT MANDATORY BUT IS COZY.
* We are now going to do some Barrows. There are many ways to get there so choose which you want or unlock it before starting. We are only after tank gear so probably don't need to do much more than 100 chests. Use Wind Wave. Morytania hard for more runes is locked behind 70 prayer so not worth doing at this stage. Kill 2 skeletons 1 bloodworm every run to maintain blood runes.
* 78 Magic -> Boost to 83 and make a Barrows portal in POH
* Salve Graveyard portal (Home teleport, recharge prayer on altar/pool, take salve graveyard portal->BKR fairy ring->Boat to barrows)
* ^ Making Agility Potions to jump the wall is optional
* Complete barrows until you have Tank helm, Plate, Legs
}}

End of Episode 7

===Episode 8 - Herblore through Perilous Moons===
{{Youtube|hvmm5TXgupw}}

{{Checklist|title=Herblore|
* Dump all your herblore experience. If 70 achieved, skip to completing Song of the Elves then return to this step
* Make Super Strengths & equal amount of Super Attack
* Use Harralanders, Avantoe & Irits in Mastering Mixology (Don't grind them all incase the ratios aren't correct. 10k+ is good then top up)
* Complete the Grapple Diary steps and use all lamps on Herblore
}}
{{Checklist|title=Song of the Elves|
* You may need to obtain a Runite Bar
* Runite Bar - If crystal key open Crystal Chest in Taverley. If not/no luck, trade Rune Legs in at the Nest in Aldarin for guaranteed Runite Bar
* Complete Song of the Elves
* Make 10+ Phoenix Necklaces
}}
* Seren Video guide - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XRZVxU-umX8
{{Youtube|XRZVxU-umX8}}
{{Checklist|title=Perilous Moons|
* Camp Perilous Moons until Eclipse & Blood (Green logging optional) [I don't recommend Birdhouse runs/Farm contracts while there]
* (Step unders are very recommended until they start hitting 16s)
* I recommend killing all 3 until 70 prayer is banked, then you can do 1kc runs if only 1 outstanding set
* Zombie Axe Eclipse on Slash (Step under every hit)
* Zombie Axe Blue Moon on Crush (Use the Boppers if you get them, step under every hit)
* Zombie Axe Blood Moon on Slash (Use DDS specials for this one. Steps under only when you see the blood leave your character)
* WHEN 60 PRAYER BANKED GET CHIVALRY WITH VARLAMORE PRAYER METHOD (Wave 1 colloseum for Sunfire Splinters)
* IF 70 PRAYER BANKED GET PIETY WITH VARLAMORE PRAYER METHOD
* While doing Perilous Moons you should hopefully bank and finish off 70 herblore if not already
* Perilous Moons Loot:
* Supercompost: Mine 2:1 Volcanic Ash:Compost and turn them into Ultra Compost
* Dump all banked prayer experience
* Water orbs: Make Battlestaffs & alch (You can alch the staffs while doing the next hunter staff and repeat the process)
* Maple & Yew Seeds: FARM BROTHER
}}

{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|

I would only recommend the Blade Route if you enjoy Corrupted Gauntlet, but the Noxious Halberd Route may require alts to effectively do and may be a bit more boring but both are routed below and are very similar. (I did the Blade route so the Halberd Route is theorycrafted rather than tested. The guide will mention when you detour BUT if you are doing Blade Route, DO NOT make a Blade before the BOFA. You will be staying until 2x Enhanced Weapon Seeds.

The meta of Slayer these days is to ignore Slayer points entirely outside of buying items and Turael/Aya skip with a blocklist that consists of Turael tasks and not higher slayer masters (once the slayer update comes you can have both block lists which will be very OP)

* Order of points usage: Bigger & Badder, Blocking Tasks, Slayer Helmet, Ring Bling, Broad Arrows

<!-- Bank 203 -->
{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|
* Withdraw: Bow of Fardhinen, Full Crystal, Shayzien Armour 5 (all pieces), Teleport Runes, Antipoison, few food & potions, Dramen Staff

* Head West and kill 1 Lizardman Shaman (Wear the Shayzien armour. You can just stand still by a wall if you want you only need 1 kill) [Kourend Hard Diary]

* Head to Mount Karuulm
* Buy Brimstone boots and kill 1 Wyrm [Kourend Hard Diary]

* Talk to Tyss to complete Kourend Hard Diary (Lamp on Herblore)
* Now we have the Bone Crusher, Ash Sanctifier & Soul Bearer we can begin the slayer grind towards Raids. This is where we can detour towards the Noxious Halberd if you did not get the Blade of Saeldor

{{Var|bankNumber|{{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}}}
<!-- Slayer Grind -->
{{Checklist|title=Slayer Grind|
* Similar to before we are going to be Turael skipping but now that we have hopefully bought everything, slayer points are no longer needed & instead of doing a task every 50th, we can do a task every time we get assigned a good one.
* Use the occult altar in your POH to easily swap between Lunars, Arceus & Ancient Spellbook 
* Astral Contact Duradel for a task. The only tasks you are looking for are 
* Ankou (Barrage in Catacombs, no alt needed)
* Bloodvelds (Barrage with Alts in Catacombs or Saeldor them. Extend if barraging)
* Dagannoth (Barrage with Alts in Catacombats or Saeldor them)
* Black Demons (Demonic Gorillas with Saeldor & Bow of Faerdhinen (Arclight/Zombie Axe if no Blade))
* Greater Demons (Tormented Demons with Dark Demonbane (Ahrim Staff or Blue Moon staff) and Arclight))
* Dust Devils (Ice Barrage in Catacombs. Extend ASAP)
* Nechryaeel (Ice Barrage in Catacombs. Extend Asap)
* If Duradel doesn’t offer any of these tasks, Astral Contact Aya and replace your task streak with a new assignment. You should be in your Turael slayer gear from earlier in the guide until you pull an above task, then change to the gear accordingly
* Drops wise we are ideally after 4 Zenyte Shards & 3 Tormented Synapses. On drop rate and including all other tasks, we will probably see 87 Slayer at this point. Continue to 92 if you are rushing Noxious Halberd. Once you have all 4 Zenytes & 3 Tormented Synapses we can leave slayer for a while.
* Zenyte Order: Anguish -> Suffering -> Tormented Bracelet -> Torture Amulet
* Tormented Synapse Order: Purging Staff -> Scorching Bow -> Emberlight (Revert the Purging Staff to Scorching Bow when your Arclight has 0 charges)
* You will need 74 Fletching for Scorching Bow. If you bought Broader Fletching you can make Broad Arrows until 74 which are very fast. Cut Maple Logs while farming Seaweed Spores and then make them Headless + Broad while doing Fishing Trawler for Angler Outfit (Tempoross Combat Achievement). 
* If you obtain 87 Slayer, the trident is optional depending if you plan to kill Doom of Mokhaiotl for Eye of Ayak (very dangerous for HCIM for accessable)
* If you skipped Blade of Saeldor you can get Kraken Whip which is decent before Nox Hally.
}}

End of Episode 11

{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|
* Calculate your crafting supplies required via molten glass to obtain 87/90/93 respectively (87 is for Zulrah, 90 Yama, 93 not too important)
* Withdraw: Adamant Pickaxe, Knife, Teak Log, 1Mil Coins, Camulet, 3x waterskin, Humidify Runes
* Teleport to POH -> Lunar Spellbook
* Camulet to inside. Upgrade to infinite charges then camulet outside
* Mine however many sand your calculations have shown
* Superglass make all the Molten Glass with Giant Seaweed
* Blow all the glass until whatever level you are after (I’d recommend 87 minimum for Zulrah or push 90 for Yama)
* As mentioned earlier, you can blow this glass at Auburn & complete 2 totems nearby for passive fletching experience while bank standing & also unlocking the Vale Totem items passively. Use Maple Logs until you unlock Yew Logs from Zulrah

<!-- Bank 211 -->
{{Checklist|title=Bank {{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}|
* Withdraw: Zenyte Shards, Chaos/Death Runes (29,000/14,500 per Onyx) [You may need to buy more], Karamja Gloves, Teleport Runes, Dramen Staff, House tab, Banana, Zombie Monkey Greegree, Chisel, Wily Cat

* Fairy ring -> BLP

* Infuse the Zenyte’s and Onyx’s together
* Hunt Orange spices for +5 boosts as necessary and create your Zenyte Jewellry

{{Var|bankNumber|{{#expr:{{#var:bankNumber}}+1}}}}
<!-- Zulrah -->
{{Checklist|title=Zulrah |
* Once you have a ring of suffering & Necklace of Anguish we can kill Zulrah fairly safely. However the food drops were nerfed so it may be worth grinding slightly better food as Zulrah can hit hard and you are close to a lot of more dangerous PvM. Anglerfish are very good for almost any and all instances of late game PvM but require 82 Fishing & 84 Cooking to obtain. I would recommend knocking this out to get it done at either Tempoross (Max XP method) or 3t Barbarian Fishing. If you afked Karambwans a lot you will probably have 70+ right now so barb fishing is very good. 82 Fishing is about a 20 hour grind. Anglerfish are good for Zulrah, Doom, Yama & ToB. Alternatively Zulrah is still accessible with Potatoes & Cheese with Karambwan combo eats as long as you are disciplined on teleports if you get spammed with range attacks.
* Gear: (Make sure Suffering is imbued & recoil effect activated. Replace Inferno with Accumulator if you don’t have (I preferred a bit extra range defence for tanz phases). Rune pouch with ‘Cure Me’ missing
* As we have no good way to cure venom right now we will use the ‘Cure Me’ Lunar spell. Using this we want to camp only range (which is very effective) until we get a Serpentine Visage drop or we unlock Antivenoms.
* When fighting Zulrah, the Green Phase & Red phase are straight forward, but the Tanz phase I would recommending eating whenever you lose health above what your food heals (if 18 health under max, eat a Karambwan, if hit a 40, double eat and be prepared for teleporting)
* With this set up, Teleports should roughly self sustain. Outside of that, bank with Lunar Spell to Catherby and run from the Charter boat (Agility highly optional)
}}

End of Episode 12

<!-- Dragon Warhammer -->
{{Checklist|title=Dragon Warhammer |
* Excellent for many PvM encounters and you will use this to grind an Elder Maul over time. I would highly recommend the 2 alt red X method using a Bow of Faerdhinen for over 160 kills/hour. This does require 2 alts but they can then afk for 25 minutes once set up. They will need to be reset up if you get crashed or a clue hunter does their step. Wear a ring of wealth and you should get enough Crystal Keys from this grind to upgrade your Jewellry boxes to the max.
